item.title: Top Dentists 2026 Survey
item.description: Welcome to the 2026 What’s Up? Top Dentists Peer Review Survey. At What’s Up? Media, we believe there is great value to our readers in a peer review survey.

item.title: When it comes to grief, for children, the play is the thing
item.description: Children don’t grieve the way adults do. They move in and out of grief. A child may become quieter, more withdrawn or have emotional outbursts that seem to come out of nowhere.

item.title: Event Picks for March 2026
item.description: A list of our favorite events around Annapolis, Eastern Shore and beyond for the month of March. Event dates may be subject to change.

item.title: At St. John’s College, the Art Experience Begins With Questions
item.description: Winds of change are bringing fresh air to the Elizabeth Myers Mitchell Art Museum at St. John’s College.

item.title: Ringing in the Wedding: Grayson & Caroline
item.description: Caroline and Grayson embraced a winter wonderland theme for their New Year’s Eve wedding at Severna Park United Methodist Church and The Westin Annapolis.

item.title: Embrace Waterside Living at its Finest at Sunset Wharf
item.description: Welcome to Sunset Wharf, an exclusive 28 unit duplex development nestled in the serene Bay Bridge Marina.

item.title: Celebrating Women’s History Month at Museums and Sites
item.description: In March, we celebrate all tremendous women during Women’s History Month. Thankfully, our region is home to several museums, exhibits, and sites that offer historic context about female leaders, movements, and culture.

item.title: Maryland DNR to Renovate Albert Powell Fish Hatchery
item.description: The Maryland Department of Natural Resources (DNR) is embarking on a comprehensive renovation of the Albert Powell Fish Hatchery, in partnership with the Department of General Services.

item.title: Maryland’s 2026 Muskrat Trapping Season Extended in Select Maryland Counties
item.description: The revised season will now close March 22 to make up for unfavorable weather conditions in January and February, including extensive ice coverage, that impacted trapping in parts of the state.

item.title: What's Up? This Weekend 3/4
item.description: March is marching in with music, momentum, and plenty of Irish spirit. From intimate live performances and high-energy basketball to creative nights out, grand openings, and a can’t-miss used book sale, the week offers something for every interest.
